selector.rationale: Bilateral punctate superficial keratitis and stromal immune ring formation support immune-mediated keratitis, with positive Chikungunya virus PCR results and IgM serologic test suggesting a viral trigger

rejected.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
rejected.why: Lack of heterochromia and atrophy of the iris, which are characteristic features of Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
